national_news.title: PM Modi Addresses Golden Jubilee of Jaigopal Garodia Hindu Vidyalaya in Chennai
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi spoke at the golden jubilee celebrations of Jaigopal Garodia Hindu Vidyalaya in Chennai, Tamil Nadu.
Highlighted India's manufacturing growth, noting that defence exports increased 50-fold and electronics exports grew 11-fold since 2014.
Stated that the number of cities with Metro rail connectivity has expanded from five in 2014 to 25 currently.

national_news.title: PM Modi Inaugurates Development Projects Worth Rs 13,000 Crore in Tamil Nadu
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated and laid foundation stones for infrastructure projects worth over Rs 13,000 crore at IIT-Madras.
Dedicated the Sudha Gopalakrishnan Brain Centre at IIT Madras, aimed at mapping over 100 human brains to create 3D cellular atlases.
Inaugurated the Poonamallee-Vadapalani stretch (Corridor 4) of Phase Two of the Chennai Metro Rail Project built at Rs 4,900 crore.

national_news.title: Supreme Court Directs Authorities on Peaceful Protests and Public Services
bullets: Supreme Court directed authorities to ensure peaceful protesters are not illegally detained and free movement is allowed.
Instructed the Centre to maintain normal operations for metro services, ensure uninterrupted internet, and avoid obstructing lawyers.
Issued notice to the Centre on a plea seeking contempt proceedings over alleged violations of previous court directions regarding public movement.

national_news.title: RBI Tightens Rupee Derivatives Rules and Cuts Dollar Transaction Limit
bullets: Reserve Bank of India reduced the threshold for foreign exchange derivative transactions without underlying exposure from $100 million to $5 million.
Introduced a Foreign Exchange Risk Reserve (FERR), requiring authorized dealers to maintain a 20% cash reserve for qualifying derivative contracts exceeding $2 million.
Aims to curb currency speculation, strengthen market discipline, and ensure orderly foreign exchange market operations.

national_news.title: Pradhan Mantri Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana Completes First Year
bullets: The Pradhan Mantri Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana (PMDDKY) completed one year of implementation across 100 selected Aspirational Agricultural Districts.

The six-year initiative converges 36 Central schemes across 11 Ministries and Departments, along with State and private sector interventions, to boost productivity, irrigation, credit access, and post-harvest infrastructure.
Operates under a three-tier implementation structure and utilizes 121 indicators across District Action Plans to track progress.

national_news.title: India Reiterate Stand on J&K and Counter Pakistan at United Nations
bullets: India exercised its Right of Reply in the Fourth Committee of the UN General Assembly in New York, slamming Pakistan for spreading falsehoods about Jammu and Kashmir.

MP Mahima Kumari Mewar highlighted human rights violations by Pakistan in illegally occupied areas, while MP Priya Saroj addressed the Sixth Committee emphasizing India's zero-tolerance for misconduct by UN personnel.
India's Permanent Mission to the UN Conference on Disarmament warned Pakistan that nuclear threats will not deter India from responding to terrorist attacks.

national_news.title: CAQM Reviews Stubble Burning Prevention Measures in Punjab Hotspots
bullets: A high-level team of the Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM) reviewed paddy stubble burning prevention measures in Amritsar and Tarn Taran districts of Punjab.
The review focused on effective in-situ and ex-situ utilization of paddy straw, deployment of Crop Residue Management (CRM) machinery, and establishing industrial supply chains for balers.
District administrations have set up control rooms, help desks, and deployed nodal officers for field patrolling to curb winter air pollution in the NCR.

national_news.title: India's Lighthouse Transformation and Maritime Tourism Growth
bullets: India boasts a coastline stretching over 11,000 km with 205 lighthouses, of which 75 have been developed as major tourism destinations by the Directorate General of Lighthouses and Lightships (DGLL).
Lighthouse tourism surged from about 4 lakh visitors in 2014 to 18.63 lakh in 2024–25, supported by a newly launched common digital ticketing portal.
All lighthouses in India are now solar-powered and equipped with 87 Automatic Identification System (AIS) shore stations for enhanced maritime safety and situational awareness.

national_news.title: India Reaffirms J&K Stance and Addresses Security Issues at UN Committees
bullets: India exercised its Right of Reply at the Fourth Committee of the UN General Assembly in New York, with MP Mahima Kumari Mewar reiterating that Jammu and Kashmir remains an integral and inalienable part of India.

MP Priya Saroj delivered India's national statement at the 81st session of the UNGA Sixth Committee, emphasizing a zero-tolerance policy towards misconduct and criminal conduct by UN officials and mission experts.

At the UNGA First Committee on Disarmament, Senior Adviser Anmol Sher Bedi highlighted India's self-defense actions under Operation Sindoor and warned against using nuclear threats to shield cross-border terrorism.

national_news.title: India Modernizes Lighthouses and Promotes Maritime Tourism Infrastructure
bullets: Under the Directorate General of Lighthouses and Lightships (DGLL), India has developed 75 out of 205 lighthouses along its 11,000 km coastline as tourist destinations, boosting visitor count from 4 lakh in 2014 to 18.63 lakh in 2024–25.
All lighthouses in India are now 100% solar-powered, transitioning from traditional fuel lamps to energy-efficient LED flashers and modern navigational equipment.

To strengthen maritime safety, 87 Automatic Identification System (AIS) shore stations aligned with the International Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea (SOLAS) have been set up at lighthouse locations.

bihar_news.title: Bihar CM sets 2028 deadline for Patna Metro project completion
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary inspected the Patna Metro Rail project along Nehru Path and set a completion deadline of 2028.
Directed authorities to construct two foot overbridges (FOBs) on Nehru Path near JD Women's College and High Court roundabout-Bihar Museum junction.
Emphasized strict adherence to quality, safety norms, traffic management, and minimal public disruption.

bihar_news.title: Bihar CM urges Centre for two BHU centres and ₹5,275 crore for colleges
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary urged Union Education Minister Pralhad Joshi to establish two Banaras Hindu University (BHU) centres in Bihar.
Demanded ₹5,275 crore at ₹25 crore per college for infrastructure development in 211 newly opened government degree colleges.
Pressed for expediting the re-establishment of Vikramshila University near Bhagalpur after land transfer.

bihar_news.title: Bihar unveils Ease of Doing Business Act, 2026 to attract investments
bullets: Bihar enacted the Ease of Doing Business Act, 2026, introducing self-certification, time-bound approvals, and a single nodal agency for clearances.
Entrepreneurs can obtain a Certificate of In-Principle Approval (CIPA) valid for three years via the Single Window System.
Prescribed approval timelines are 5 working days for micro enterprises, 10 for small, and 15 for medium and large enterprises.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Delays Decision on Maa Sita Women's University
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Chaudhary instructed Higher Education Minister Sanjay Singh Tiger to postpone any decision regarding the proposed Maa Sita Women's University.
Consultations with stakeholders and further action will commence only after the conclusion of the ongoing Bihar Legislative Council election process.
A formal meeting involving all relevant stakeholders will be convened to review suggestions before finalizing the establishment of the university.

bihar_news.title: BIADA Managing Director Inspects Patliputra Industrial Area
bullets: Bihar Industrial Area Development Authority (BIADA) Managing Director Naveen Kumar inspected the Patliputra Industrial Area to review infrastructure, data centre operations, and industrial units.
Directives were issued for time-bound actions against encroachments, unauthorised constructions, improper parking, and sanitation lapses within the industrial zone.
An access control system has been ordered at all entry gates to regulate private vehicle movement, alongside strict measures against waste dumping on roadsides.
